meta_description:
283 likes, 14 comments - assetyogi on June 27, 2025: "Think Registry Means You Own the Property?

Registry Is Just One Step—True Ownership Requires:

📌The seller must have a clear and valid legal title to the property.

📌You must have completed the full payment for the property.

📌You should have received physical possession of the property.

Essential documents like the Mother Deed, NOC, and Tax Receipts must be in order and verified.

How to Secure Your Property Ownership

📌Verify Seller’s Title Thoroughly
📌Ensure Full and Clear Payment
📌Collect and Check All Original Documents
📌Obtain a Possession Letter
📌Seek Legal Advice Before Finalizing

(property ownership, property registry, Supreme Court property judgment, legal property title, real estate documents, registry vs ownership, Indian property law, secure property purchase, real estate India, property legal advice)
#property #govt".
